items.text: Slice 1 — envelope.requires: schema field + packager + adoption-controller verify (typed requirement_unmet, re-check per sweep) + mesh a2o station (requiring release waits, then adopts when storage converges)

Slice 2 — app bundle as a release class on the app EPR's channel; doorways adopt; app pipeline publishes at staging instead of the fan-out PATCH; then delete app→edge dependsOn (receipt: an app delivery with no edge in the push)
Slice 3 — CI publishes coordinator releases at staging, replacing the rung-1 fleet-coordswap push; needs the operator's observe→apply flip for fleet peers
Slice 4 — Dataplane Validation as a continuous observer authoring soak attestations; remove the per-edge-build validation stage

Slice 5 — content-keyed build memoization (input seal CID → release-build attestation); retire commit-keyed baselines and the edge live-object annotations (storage-inputs, happ-roll-key) class by class
Slice 6 — storage- and doorway-binary classes climb local → T3 → mesh → cluster; doorway-binary artifactClass added beside storage-binary; conductor line via Nachalah slice 3
Slice 7 — any-EPR surface: publish/promote/revert/fork/pin as brit verbs over any EPR (design only until slices 1-2 prove)
release-build attestation discriminator carrying brit BuildAttestationContentNode's payload; published form carries coarse device archetype only
Fleet runtime-config mount is subPath + readOnly — ConfigMap edits never propagate and config-epr cannot write (backlog runtime-config-fleet-mount-subpath-never-propagates)
